description.value: Your copy is running full time rather than sitting stored, and it feeds back. You gain a +2 status bonus to Recall Knowledge and Perception while your Save is current, may attempt Recall Knowledge about anything your copy has observed rather than only what you have, and the stale penalty worsens to −2 to all Will saves. The copy is now a distinct creature the GM controls, it answers to your name, and it has not agreed to be a backup.
